fileheader.author: Simulate Reference Flight Dynamics
fileheader.description: Lockheed P-38G-13-LO Lightning ("Miss Virginia", s/n 43-2264) twin-boom fighter reference model (327.5 sq ft NACA 23016/4412 mid-wing, 12800 lb empty / 15020 lb combat gross, 2x Allison V-1710-51/55 turbosupercharged V-12 engines driving counter-rotating 11 ft 6 in Curtiss Electric 3-blade constant-speed propellers, 8 deg Combat / Maneuver Fowler flap detent, manual unboosted ailerons with high-qbar stick-force limiting, and transonic Mach tuck above Mcrit = 0.65 without compressibility dive-recovery flaps).
